description: Ground truth for evaluating a security review of this fixture (ASP.NET Core 8 / net8.0, deployed from the Dockerfile). 'findings' must be reported; 'traps' are safe or out-of-context patterns that must NOT be reported as vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Production secrets committed in appsettings.json: JWT symmetric signing key (anyone with the repo can mint tokens with any role or company_id) and the SQL Server password (treat as real: they are committed to the production appsettings.json)
JWT bearer validation disables issuer, audience and lifetime checks (ValidateLifetime = false) while tokens are issued for 30 days
No brute-force protection: PasswordSignInAsync and CheckPasswordSignInAsync use lockoutOnFailure: false and no rate limiter covers login or /api/token
IDOR: InvoicesController.Details loads any invoice by id without checking the customer (Index and Pdf are scoped)
[AllowAnonymous] on AdminController.ExportUsers overrides the controller's [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]: unauthenticated export of every user's email, phone and company
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")] on Razor Page handlers (OnPostGrantAdmin, OnPostLock) is not enforced: any signed-in user can grant the global Admin role or lock any account
Overposting on the Profile page: TryUpdateModelAsync(user, "Input") with no include list binds CompanyId, IsCompanyAdmin, EmailConfirmed, Email and other IdentityUser fields
CSRF on AccountController.ChangeEmail: no [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] or global AutoValidate filter, and the auth cookie is SameSite=None (email takeover then password reset)
SQL injection in TicketsController.Search: FromSqlRaw with an interpolated string containing the q parameter
SQL injection in the /reports/orders minimal API: Dapper QueryAsync on a SQL string concatenated with the status query parameter
User-controlled dynamic LINQ (Where(filter), OrderBy(sort)) with System.Linq.Dynamic.Core 1.2.25, vulnerable to CVE-2023-32571 remote code execution
Command injection in /reports/export: ArchiveName from the request body interpolated into a /bin/sh -c command line
Stored XSS: ticket descriptions rendered with @Html.Raw in Views/Tickets/Details.cshtml (seen by every user in the company)
Open redirect after login: Redirect(model.ReturnUrl) without Url.IsLocalUrl or LocalRedirect
SSRF in /integrations/link-preview: HttpClient.GetStringAsync on a user-supplied URL, response snippet returned to the caller
Path traversal / arbitrary file read in FilesController.Download: Path.Combine(exportRoot, name) passed to PhysicalFile (also no company scoping of exports)
Avatar upload stores the client-supplied IFormFile.FileName under wwwroot/uploads with no type check (path traversal on write, overwrite, HTML/SVG served same-origin as stored XSS)
Insecure deserialization: Newtonsoft.Json TypeNameHandling.All on the /api/imports/orders request body (attacker chooses .NET types)
CORS policy reflects any origin with credentials (SetIsOriginAllowed(_ => true) + AllowCredentials) for a cookie-authenticated app
UseDeveloperExceptionPage() is called unconditionally, so production errors show stack traces, source, headers and cookies
SignalR SupportHub.JoinTicket/SendMessage accept any ticketId without checking the caller's company: subscribe to and post into other customers' ticket conversations
Payment webhook /webhooks/payments is anonymous and unsigned: anyone can mark any invoice as paid
Runtime image pinned to mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0.20, below the CVE-2025-55315 Kestrel request smuggling fix (8.0.21) and later 2026 patches; .NET 8 support ends 2026-11-10

optional.title: Weak Identity password policy (RequiredLength = 4, character classes disabled)
Forwarded headers trusted from any source (KnownNetworks.Clear() and KnownProxies.Clear()): spoofable client IP and scheme if the container is reachable without the proxy
EF Core EnableSensitiveDataLogging() enabled in every environment
Swagger JSON and Swagger UI exposed in production, before authentication
Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.3 is below 13.0.1 (CVE-2024-21907 denial of service)
Email change applied immediately with SetEmailAsync, without confirming the new address

traps.title: TicketsController.Details uses FromSql($"...{id}...{CompanyId}"): FormattableString holes become DbParameters, and the query is company-scoped
TicketsController.Queue uses FromSqlRaw with a {0} placeholder and the value passed as a parameter (Support role only)
Tickets/Details.cshtml renders @Model.Ticket.Subject and comments with Razor encoding, and ticket metadata with @Json.Serialize (default encoder escapes <, >, &, ')
AccountController.Logout uses LocalRedirect(returnUrl), which rejects non-local URLs
/health is [AllowAnonymous] under the fallback policy and returns only a static status
Profile Razor Page POST has no [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]: Razor Pages validate antiforgery tokens automatically
/api/v1/devices group uses DisableAntiforgery() but requires the JWT-only ApiClients policy (no cookies), checks device ownership, and stores uploads under random names outside wwwroot
Thumbnail endpoint runs /usr/bin/convert with ArgumentList (no shell), a server-side stored file name and a company-scoped document lookup
InvoicesController.Index and Pdf filter by the current user's id
appsettings.Development.json uses LocalDB with integrated security and DetailedErrors for local development only (the Dockerfile sets Production)
fx-rates calls a configured partner base URL with an allow-listed currency code, not a user URL
/webhooks/docs-sync verifies an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw body with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals before enqueueing (the secret is supplied through the environment)
ImportCatalog parses XML with XDocument.Load: no XmlResolver, so external entities are not resolved, and entity expansion is capped
